notes: Desktop 2.7.1 improves the new StartupJobs/Indeed discovery integration. Indeed now stops after the first direct HTTP 403 and switches to a normal read-only Chromium session using the persistent Job Agent browser profile; no consent buttons are clicked and no access challenge is bypassed. StartupJobs discovery now prefers the semantic vacancy heading so company/location badges are not glued into titles. Four-source review breadth increases from 24 to 36 ranked vacancies and browser evidence capacity from 10 to 12. StartupJobs.cz and Indeed.cz remain discovery-only; final application submission remains manual.
